articles.title: SHOKK Vortex
articles.summary: Deep blue surface with a red-orange logarithmic spiral; moire rings shift and drain colour with angle. A dark navy surface with a clean red hairline spiral, like a swirling drain; at distance only the arms and the red lines read, the two blues blend.
articles.what: Logarithmic spiral color drain - dual-spiral Moire interference shifts with angle Up close: A single large spiral of curved arms in alternating navy and mid-blue wedges, each edge drawn by a thin red-orange line that is slightly pixel-stepped. All arms meet at one hot centre point, with a straight seam line running left from it. From a distance: A dark navy surface with a clean red hairline spiral, like a swirling drain; at distance only the arms and the red lines read, the two blues blend. Measured spec (average): metal 94, roughness 129, coat 120. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "SHOKK Vortex" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood or roof: the single spiral centre works as a hero point
Avoid splitting across several panels: the centre only lands once
Numbers are fine on the flat navy wedges in white; avoid sitting a number across the red centre where all lines converge.
None: one large spiral already fills the panel
Pairs well with: black, chrome, white, orange.
pitfalls: Not a tiled all-over pattern: the render is ONE giant spiral with a single centre, so on a car the centre lands in one place
Not a holographic colour shift: colours are fixed navy and red
Avoid: numbers over the spiral centre, next to other busy patterns.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 94 (pearl-level metal), roughness 129 (satin or eggshell), clearcoat 120 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: numbers over the spiral centre, next to other busy patterns.
